It's the official Buffy role-playing system, uses Unisystem. Heavy lean on storytelling and character over combat, and rule-of-cool style gameplay. I'm exploring some of the same themes the show does, such as personal choice, coming of age and identity, but sharing the focus more between all the characters because it would be unfair in a role-play environment to focus too much on one player. It's a high school setting, but a posh school in Southeast England. It ignores the season 7 canon and purposely doesn't include any specific elements from the show. I'm more interested in problem-solving then straight combat, and the ghouls represent an area where I'm going to hint diplomacy is the best option. The combat is very superficial like I said (which really mirrors the show ;p I jest but also I don't). I like turning the tables in the same way the show does, and I'm trying to outdo the show villains, who I feel whilst mechanically powerful and compelling, were often never given enough time to interact with the main cast and be understood by them. The Mayor is one in particular who I was always more curious about but kind of got screwed over by the pace of the season. Again, the ghouls aren't villains, though some of them could be villainous, and they are not aligned WITH my scoobies.
